name: AI-Powered Freelance Opportunity Aggregator — Hard Filter

parameters.query:
SELECT *
FROM public.opportunities
WHERE hard_filter_version IS DISTINCT FROM 'v1.6'
ORDER BY id ASC;

UPDATE public.opportunities
SET
  hard_filter_status = $1,
  hard_filter_reasons = $2::text[],
  hard_filter_version = $3,
  hard_filtered_at = $4::timestamptz
WHERE id = $5::bigint
RETURNING
  id,
  hard_filter_status,
  hard_filter_reasons,
  hard_filter_version,
  hard_filtered_at;
